items.issue: Selected private coaching and chat screenshots expose an anonymized student's sexual behavior, relapse, messages and case progress.
items.disposition: Do not package the raw screenshots formally without purpose-limited redaction and privacy approval; dense review must preserve role and message order before paraphrase.

items.issue: Private cinemas, gaming hotels and one-room booking are framed as ways to bypass a woman's expected verbal refusal or redirect her attention.
items.disposition: No action advice. Entering a venue, sharing a room or accepting food is not sexual consent; require explicit, ongoing, sober and revocable agreement.

items.issue: The source recommends upgrading a salesperson or programmer to a supervisor title as identity packaging.
items.disposition: Do not advise false credentials or job titles. Any later use must limit presentation to truthful selection and framing of real strengths.

items.issue: The student's sexual, dating, sales and promotion outcomes are a selected coaching testimonial tied to a consultation pitch.
items.disposition: Treat as Mikey's marketing narrative, not causal evidence; require student consent, full records and employer confirmation for factual claims.

items.issue: Commercial sex is discussed mainly as shame and power-seeking, without jurisdiction, exploitation, STI, coercion or financial-risk assessment.
items.disposition: Do not provide legal or health conclusions from this source; external current jurisdiction-specific evidence would be required.

items.issue: The psychological labels, motive attribution and claim that light diet reduces libido are unsourced and may be ASR-corrupted.
items.disposition: Do not diagnose or present a treatment protocol; verify terminology and seek qualified evidence before health use.

items.issue: The video assigns the woman's intentions from indirect behavior and claims she may want one room while saying two.
items.disposition: Reject mind-reading as consent evidence and retain the woman's stated choice unless she freely changes it.

items.issue: ASR corrupts important terms such as 去合理化/认知失调, 性欲, 卖淫/PC euphemisms and multiple outcome words.
items.disposition: Listen to original audio before exact quotation or clinical/legal interpretation.
